ceu: ✦ The square between Mars and Uranus

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up home and family.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1811673561000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.
